title: Region splice
description: Three waveform selections move and resize within shared bounds without colliding.
useCase: Mark several passages in one recording while maintaining minimum durations and separation.
interaction: Drag a region or its selected edges; use arrows, Shift, Home and End; toggle quarter-second snapping or reset.
reducedMotion: Editing tracks the pointer directly, without inertial or decorative animation.
limitations: Deterministic synthetic waveform and three local selection regions. No audio decoding, playback, export or destructive clip edits.
look: Dark plum audio editor card with a pink waveform track, three translucent rounded region boxes (one highlighted with edge handles), monospace ruler and timing readouts.
motion: Dragging a region or edge handle moves or resizes it 1:1 with the pointer, stopping at neighbours and a 4 s minimum, optionally snapping to 0.25 s; no easing.
adapt: `shiftRegion` enforces bounds using `GAP`, `MINIMUM` and `LENGTH`; `start`, `move` and `end` handle pointer capture, snapping to quarter seconds when `snap` is on, and `key` maps arrows, Home and End. Replace `INITIAL` and the synthetic `PEAKS` waveform with decoded audio peaks.
